name: Transaction pulse
description: Live transaction profile: commits, rollbacks, deadlocks side-by-side with a proportional flow bar showing commit:rollback ratio. Bind each row to its receiver metric. Pulsing LED on each line glows green/amber/red driven by the deadlock count.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.label: Instance
parameters.description: Pin a specific service.instance.id when the service has multiple replicas.

spec.template:
Commits {{ format commits.value 'none' 0 }}
Rollbacks {{ format rollbacks.value 'none' 0 }}
Deadlocks {{ format deadlocks.value 'none' 0 }}
commit:rollback ratio
{{ format commits.value 'none' 0 }}
{{ format rollbacks.value 'none' 0 }}
spec.styles: .txp { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; gap: 0.85rem; } .txp .rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; flex: 0 0 auto; } .txp .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 6%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 14%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); } .txp .row.commit   { color: var(--color-sage-600); } .txp .row.rollback { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .txp .row.deadlock { color: var(--color-rust-600); } .txp .dot { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-graphite-400); justify-self: center; animation: txp-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .txp .dot.dot-ok, .txp .dot.vellum-th-ok   { background: var(--color-sage-500);  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-sage-500)  22%, transparent); } .txp .dot.vellum-th-warn { background: var(--color-amber-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-amber-500) 24%, transparent); } .txp .dot.vellum-th-bad  { background: var(--color-rust-500);  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-rust-500)  28%, transparent); } @keyframes txp-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(0.78); opacity: 0.55; } } .txp .ico { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; opacity: 0.85; } .txp .lbl { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-graphite-700); } .txp .val { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-graphite-700); } .txp .val.vellum-th-warn { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .txp .val.vellum-th-bad  { color: var(--color-rust-600); } .txp .flow { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: auto; } .txp .cap { font-size: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .txp .bar { display: flex; height: 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 8%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); overflow: hidden; } .txp .seg { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; transition: flex-grow 600ms ease-out; padding: 0 0.4rem; } .txp .seg span { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; color: white; opacity: 0.95; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .txp .seg.ok  { background: var(--color-sage-500);  } .txp .seg.bad { background: var(--color-amber-500); }

dataBindings.name: deadlocks
dataBindings.description: postgresql.deadlocks — cumulative deadlocks. Drives the row's pulsing dot color.
